content: === Introduction ===
Leber is a surname, and may refer to:
<info> Annedore Leber, German journalist and politician
<info> Ben Leber, American football player
<info> Georg Leber, German politician
<info> Jean Michel Constant Leber, French historian
<info> Julius Leber, German politician and resistance fighter
<info> Sylvie Leber, French-born Australian musician, founder of the early 1980s feminist band Toxic Shock
<info> Theodor Leber, German ophthalmologist who first described the diseases now known as Leber's congenital amaurosis and Leber's hereditary optic neuropathy
<info> Titus Leber, Austrian film director
<info> Walter Philip Leber, former Panama Canal Zone Governor
<info> Wilhelm Leber, Chief Apostle of the New Apostolic Church
